name.description: The fully qualified domain name for the A record.

ipv4addr.description: The IPv4 address to map to the domain name. Use func:nextavailableip to assign the next available IP.

view.description: The DNS view in which to create the record.

ttl.description: The time to live in seconds.

use_ttl.description: Whether to use the specified TTL value.

comment.description: A descriptive comment for the record.
